name: prompt_for_language_selection
description: Prompts the user to select their preferred language for communication.

parameters.name: selected_language
parameters.description: The language the user chooses for the conversation, indicating their preferred communication language.

children.name: prompt_for_privacy_policy_acceptance
children.description: Requests the user to accept or reject the privacy policy before providing assistance.

parameters.name: privacy_policy_acceptance
parameters.description: User's choice to accept or decline the privacy policy.

children.name: list_service_options
children.description: Presents a list of services that the chatbot can assist the user with after accepting the privacy policy.

outputs.description: A comprehensive list of services offered, including train schedules, recommended fares, transport card information, directions to stations, circulation status, installation status, and other inquiries.

name: present_available_lines
description: Displays available train lines for the specified station and prompts the user to select which line they wish to inquire about.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: The specific train line the user prefers to inquire about.

name: provide_station_information
description: Provides detailed information about the selected station, including connections, lines serving the station, and additional transport details.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: Name of the station requested by the user.

outputs.description: Information about the selected station, including lines serving the station, connections, and a web link for more details.
Details of additional transport connections available.

name: prompt_for_age_group_selection
description: Prompts the user to specify their age group to recommend suitable fare options.

parameters.name: age_group
parameters.description: User's age group for fare recommendations, categorized into specific ranges.

name: provide_tourist_ticket_information
description: Provides information about the tourist ticket, including validity, age categories, and available zones.

outputs.description: Examples and conditions related to tourist ticket usage.

name: prompt_for_user_type
description: Prompts the user to identify their relationship with the Metro system as either a tourist or a regular user to offer tailored assistance.

parameters.name: user_type
parameters.description: Indicates the user's relationship to the Metro system (visitor or regular user).

name: confirm_query_resolution
description: The chatbot confirms whether the provided information resolved the user's query.

name: present_train_lines_info
description: Provides information about the train lines available at the specified station.

outputs.description: Details of the train lines available at the user's specified station.

name: prompt_for_departure_zone_selection
description: Requests the user to specify their starting fare zone for journey planning, providing options based on the fare zones.

parameters.name: starting_zone
parameters.description: The fare zone from which the user intends to start their journey, corresponding to the user's starting station.

name: present_assistance_options
description: Provides a list of assistance options related to public transport inquiries.

outputs.description: Options include upcoming trains, recommended fares, transport card information, directions, service status, facility status, and other inquiries.

name: present_line_plans
description: Offers a choice of different metro plans for the user to download based on line inquiry.

outputs.description: Available plans include a schematic plan and a tourist plan.

name: prompt_for_current_station_name
description: Prompts the user to provide the name of their current station to assist with checking train schedules and providing train information.

parameters.name: current_station
parameters.description: The name of the station where the user is currently located.

outputs.description: List of upcoming trains with lines, directions, and arrival times.

name: provide_single_ticket_info
description: The chatbot gives specific information about the Single Ticket, including its rules and validity.

outputs.description: Details about the validity and usage of the Single Ticket
Information about the Tarjeta Multi required for loading the ticket.

name: provide_network_status_info
description: Informs the user about the current status of the metro network, including any incidents affecting specific lines and alternative transportation options.

outputs.description: Details of ongoing incidents affecting train service, including information on affected lines, current circulation issues, alternative arrangements (e.g., shuttle buses), and available transportation services.

name: present_assistance_categories
description: Lists the available categories of assistance the chatbot can provide to the user.

outputs.description: Includes options for checking upcoming trains, recommended fare types, transport card information, directions to a station, network status, and installation status.

name: provide_train_arrival_information
description: Provides detailed information about the next arriving trains at a specified station or line, including line numbers, directions, and estimated arrival times or wait times.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station specified by the user.

outputs.description: Details of the next trains arriving at the station, including line numbers, directions, and estimated arrival times.

name: provide_route_information
description: Provides detailed route information, including estimated travel time, transfer details, and an interactive map link based on the user's current station and destination.

parameters.name: start_station
parameters.description: The name of the current station; destination_station: The name of the destination station.

outputs.description: Estimated travel time, transfer information, and whether transfers are needed.
Interactive map link for the route.

name: provide_fare_recommendations
description: Offers recommended fare options based on the user's provided information, including ticket types and pricing.

outputs.description: Details of suggested fares, including single tickets and tourist passes, along with their prices based on user information.

name: provide_transport_card_details
description: Provides details about the selected type of transport card when the user requests more information about a specific card.

parameters.name: card_type
parameters.description: The type of transport card the user is inquiring about.

name: present_card_purchase_options
description: Provides information on how and where the user can purchase the selected transport card.

outputs.description: Options include Online purchase, In-person at Gestión Offices, and New application document requirements.

name: provide_new_application_documentation
description: Informs the user about the documentation required for a new request for the transport card.

outputs.description: Documentation includes a recent photograph, DNI, passport, or residence permit.

name: present_card_recharge_options
description: Lists options available for recharging the transportation card and provides a link for more info about the official app.

outputs.description: Options include Machines at stations, Official App, Stamps, CaixaBank ATMs
Link to the official app website.

name: provide_ticket_fare_options
description: Provides recommendations for available ticket types and fare options based on user's journey and previous inputs, including pricing details.

outputs.description: A comprehensive list of available fare options and ticket types, including single journey tickets, multiple-trip tickets, tourist passes, and various subscriptions, along with their respective prices.

name: present_transport_card_options
description: Lists different types of transport cards available and prompts the user to select one for more information.

outputs.description: Available transport cards include Personal Card, Multi Card, Blue Card, and Child Card (Tarjeta Personal, Tarjeta Multi, Tarjeta Azul, Tarjeta Infantil).

name: provide_multi_card_info
description: Offers information about the Multi Card type and its functionalities.

outputs.description: Description of the Multi Card features and how it can be used.

name: prompt_for_destination_zone_selection
description: Prompts the user to specify their destination fare zone for journey planning or fare recommendations.

parameters.name: destination_zone
parameters.description: Represents the fare zone or geographical zone where the user plans to travel.

name: prompt_for_station_for_facility_status
description: Asks the user to specify which station they want to check for the status of facilities.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station the user wants information about.

children.name: present_facility_status_info
children.description: Provides information about the status of facilities, such as elevators and escalators, for the specified station.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station for which the facility status is provided.

outputs.description: Details about the operational status of elevators and escalators at the specified station.
